Use the Makefile targets:

- `make test-fast` runs `pytest -m "not postgres" -q`. It skips tests marked `postgres`, so you don't need a database. This is the one the project's memory notes as the convention.
- `make test` runs the full suite with `pytest -q`. The `postgres`-marked tests are included, so you'll probably need a Postgres instance available.

I didn't run either one. I only read the Makefile.
